epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce generic entity misuse rate from >5% to 0%
requirements: R1: Validate and store protocol-specific attributes such as procedural steps and author approvals when submitting a protocol.
R2: Validate and store data-specific structures such as sample metrics and collection parameters when uploading epidemiological data.

slices.title: Patch existing backend to support protocol and data attributes
slices.jtbd: When implementing the protocol and data entity patch for this epic, I want to directly augment the existing generic material implementation, so that structural attributes are distinct without adding new API or schema layers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user wants to add a protocol, when they submit the details, then the system validates and stores protocol-specific attributes.
Given a user wants to upload epidemiological data, when they submit the data, then the system validates and stores data-specific structures.
Given a QA audit, when the patched implementation is tested, then all validations apply correctly without requiring new endpoints or DB schemas.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce protocol attribute validation errors from >5% to 0%

epics.title: Protocol and Material Revision History
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce undocumented protocol changes from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Track and store historical revisions of materials and protocols when edited and saved.
R2: Retrieve a list of historical revisions including author, timestamp, and content of past versions.

slices.title: Patch backend to record and serve material revisions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the revision tracking patch for this epic, I want to add history recording to existing save flows, so that previous versions are maintained for audit.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, when I view its detailed page, then I can see a list of historical revisions.
Given a list of revisions, when I select a past version, then I can view its historical content.
Given a QA audit, when revisions are created, then integration tests verify the history is correctly tracked and retrieved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase historical version retrieval success rate from 0% to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase application startup success rate from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Fix the runtime observation failure where the product launch fails or health check fails.

slices.title: Fix product launch and health check failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the deployment configuration or initialization code, so that the product successfully launches and passes its health check.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the product is deployed, when the launch sequence is initiated, then the process starts without failure.
Given the product has started, when the health check is probed, then it returns a healthy status.
Given a QA audit, when the stack starts, then automated E2E tests verify the product runs successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce startup crash rate from 100% to 0%
